statement.zh: 阿布西尔萨胡拉金字塔建筑群壁面场景见 Borchardt 1913《萨胡拉陵墓》图版卷。
statement.en: At Abusir, wall scenes from Sahure’s pyramid complex are documented in Borchardt 1913 Sahure Grabdenkmal plate volume.
